$comment: Known differences from the newest Claude Code snapshot, each with why. The report prints the reason beside the entry; fixing one moves it to checked.json.

gaps.call:command.register: Localix resolves undefined; Claude Code resolves { command }.
gaps.call:model.complete: Localix resolves the reply's text; Claude Code resolves { isAnswered, text, usage } (or isAnswered: false with a reason), so a mod that reads r.isAnswered sees undefined.
gaps.call:session.messages: A tool use or result carries no result object, and a tool use no text, in Localix.
gaps.call:session.usage: Localix has no session start time and gives cost only once a run reported one.
gaps.call:session.version: Localix names itself ({ version: 'localix' }), with no base or build time.
gaps.call:ui.panes: Localix lists a pane's id and title, without isFocused, isPlaced or isShown.
gaps.event:prompt.submit: Localix also passes turnId; Claude Code gives it in turn.start only.
gaps.event:session.end: Localix gives the reason only, without sessionId or resume.
gaps.event:tool.call:Write: Localix keeps its own files list beside Claude Code's file_path and content (ext/cc-tool-shapes.ts).
gaps.event:tool.check: As tool.call: the input keeps Localix's files beside Claude Code's fields.
gaps.event:turn.complete: Localix sends no usage, the turn's token totals.
gaps.event:turn.step: Localix leaves effort out when the run sets no effort Claude Code names (the fixture's run sets none).
gaps.event:ui.render:AbovePrompt: Localix's desktop surface draws only panes through ui.render.
gaps.event:ui.render:CommandOutput: Localix's desktop surface draws only panes through ui.render.
gaps.event:ui.render:Pane: Localix adds plugin and gives no props.view.
gaps.event:ui.render:PromptHint: Localix's desktop surface draws only panes through ui.render.
gaps.event:ui.render:SessionMode: Localix's desktop surface draws only panes through ui.render.
gaps.event:ui.render:Spinner: Localix's desktop surface draws only panes through ui.render.
gaps.event:ui.render:UserMessage: Localix's desktop surface draws only panes through ui.render.
gaps.result:prompt.submit: Localix's core answer has no origin.
gaps.result:tool.call:Write: Localix's core answer is { result: { content } }; Claude Code's is the tool's own result with ref and text.
gaps.result:tool.check: The fixture's permission verdict names no rule; Claude Code's names the rule that decided.
